title: incident-bot: add SLO toolkit on-call helpers and contextual diagnostics hints
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR adds a set of on-call helper utilities to the incident-bot service and integrates SLO toolkit hints into automated diagnostics and runbook linking. Motivation: during recent on-call rotations and postmortems we observed that responders lacked quick contextual hints (recent SLO regressions, recent configuration changes, and relevant runbook steps). This change surfaces compact SLO hints, runbook quick-links, and a small ranking heuristic to improve triage speed. Includes unit + integration tests and docs updates. Checklist: - [x] implement SLO hint generator - [x] add runbook quick-link scoring - [x] add telemetry counters and tracing spans - [x] add unit and integration tests - [x] update incident-bot runbooks docs - [x] update linear & jira references
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add slo_hint service and accessor + tests; 2) Integrate runbook quick-link ranking into oncall workflow; 3) Docs and telemetry + minor fixes (addressed review comments on timeouts and race conditions)
review_comments: Samir Shah: Overall direction looks good. Please add defensive checks around missing SLO metadata (we saw a NPE in a local repro).
Asha Patel: Added nil-checks + unit test that reproduces missing-metadata path (see commit 2).

Miguel Rivera: Can we limit the runbook quick-links to top-3 and add a safety fallback when no scored runbooks are returned? Also request to add a short-circuit when the oncall request originates from a scheduled maintenance context.
Asha Patel: Implemented top-3 cap and maintenance context short-circuit; added e2e test.
Sara Kim: CI initially failed on linter; style fixes applied. Please ensure telemetry metric names conform to naming conventions (changed metric name to incidentbot.slo_hint.count).
Miguel Rivera: Approved after nit fixes.
Samir Shah: Approved. Will squash and merge once CI green.

release_notes: Added on-call helpers: compact SLO hints, runbook quick-link ranking, telemetry for oncall hint usage, and docs. Improves mean time to acknowledge for incidents related to SLO regressions.
notes_for_ops: Config flag incident_bot.features.oncall_slo_hints=false to disable; rollout started behind feature flag and enabled for 10% of traffic before full rollout. Watch telemetry incidentbot.slo_hint.count and incidentbot.runbook_rank.invocations for anomalies.

test_plan: Unit + integration tests added. Manual e2e run on staging with synthetic SLO regressions and scheduled maintenance contexts. Observe metrics and traces for expected spans and counters.

importance_and_risk: Medium importance (improves oncall efficiency), low-to-medium risk. Feature behind flag; fallback to existing behavior when metadata not available.
